subject.title: Bug: Gateway falsely marks healthy local vLLM endpoints as timed out/overloaded, causing 1–23 min fallback cascades

question: Does current main still reproduce the healthy local vLLM false-timeout plus sessions_spawn gateway-latency cascade after the model-switch, auth-prewarm, and cron-preflight fixes?
rationale: Source and merged PRs prove several related slices are fixed, but the original issue needs maintainer-owned live local-provider evidence before automation can choose the remaining timeout, fallback, auth, cron, or gateway RPC surface safely.

options.title: Run current-main live repro
options.body: Keep the issue open and capture a fresh local vLLM run with provider timing, fallback decisions, gateway RPC latency, and auth-prewarm state before accepting another repair.

options.title: Close as partial duplicate
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide the remaining healthy-vLLM timeout symptoms are no longer actionable and should be refiled with fresh logs.

options.title: Route to cold-start preflight work
options.body: Keep this issue linked to the open retry/cold-start preflight PR only if maintainers confirm the remaining symptom is preflight cold-start rather than false healthy-endpoint timeout.

recommendation.title: Run current-main live repro
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and capture a fresh local vLLM run with provider timing, fallback decisions, gateway RPC latency, and auth-prewarm state before accepting another repair.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current assignee and were involved in the maintainer path for the merged provider-auth prewarm repair.
